answer_1.quote: exploring the textual aesthetics of LLMs is a highly desirable area of research. In this work, we present the first investigation into improving the aesthetic quality of text generated by LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: Textual responses with enhanced aesthetics generated by LLMs

answer_2.quote: We report the win rate (WR) in text aesthetics at both the text and image levels relative to the baseline model (GPT-4-0314).

answer_3.quote: we employ the 'LLM-as-a-judge' framework to approximate human preferences for text aesthetics.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a human evaluation to further validate the models' performance. We randomly sample fifty entries from the Arena-Hard dataset and ask human annotators to rate the aesthetics of these entries.
